title: Altered financial documents before an audit
description: Before an external audit, several approved invoices and a reconciliation workbook were found to differ from the copies held by the supplier. The investigation aims to establish which documents were changed, when, from which account and device, and whether the changes were discussed in internal messages.

sources.label: Finance file share FIN-SHARE
sources.description: Shared folder holding approved invoices and reconciliation workbooks.

sources.label: Accountant workstation AW-09
sources.description: Desktop computer of the accountant who prepared the reconciliation.

sources.label: Chat workspace export
sources.description: Export of the finance team's chat channel and direct messages.

evidence.title: Invoice INV-4471 as stored on the file share
evidence.description: The approved copy of the invoice from the supplier folder, as it exists on the file share now.
evidence.text: Invoice INV-4471. Supplier: Northgate Components Ltd. Date: 2026-06-12. Amount payable: 48,900.00. Approved by: finance manager. Document properties: last modified 2026-09-19 18:22 by user acc.rao.
custody: Handed over for comparison with supplier copy

findings: Invoice was modified three months after its date
The file properties show a modification on 2026-09-19, long after the invoice date and approval, although approved invoices should not change.
high
Amount field differs from the supplier copy
The supplier's copy shows 14,900.00 payable, while the stored copy shows 48,900.00.
high

evidence.title: Invoice INV-4471 as received from the supplier
evidence.description: The original invoice attached to the supplier's email in June, retrieved from the mail archive.
evidence.text:
From: accounts@northgate-example.test
To: payables@corp.example
Date: 2026-06-12
Subject: Invoice INV-4471
Attachment: INV-4471.pdf  Amount payable: 14,900.00
evidence.notes: Supplier confirmed the amount in writing.

findings: Attachment unchanged since receipt
The attachment's creation and modification times match the supplier's sending time, so this copy was not edited after receipt.
medium

evidence.title: File server audit log for the invoice folder
evidence.description: Access log entries for the supplier invoices folder between June and September.
evidence.text:
2026-09-19 18:20:41 open path=//finshare/invoices/northgate/INV-4471.pdf user=acc.rao host=AW-09
2026-09-19 18:22:03 write path=//finshare/invoices/northgate/INV-4471.pdf user=acc.rao host=AW-09
2026-09-19 18:22:40 write path=//finshare/invoices/northgate/INV-4488.pdf user=acc.rao host=AW-09

analyses.notes: Write event timeline for the folder.
findings: Three invoices were written to on one evening
Writes to three invoices by one user account within about two minutes, all from one workstation, in the evening after normal hours.
high
The account used is the accountant's own
The writes were made by the accountant's account from AW-09, which shows whose credentials were used but not who was seated at the keyboard.
info

evidence.title: Disk image of accountant workstation AW-09
evidence.description: Forensic image of the workstation used for the writes to the invoices.
evidence.text: NTFS volume 476 GB. Recent files list includes INV-4471.pdf and INV-4488.pdf, accessed 2026-09-19 18:20. A PDF editor was launched at 18:19.

analyses.notes: Recent file and program execution review.
findings: PDF editor was used just before the writes
A PDF editing program was started a minute before the first file was opened, which fits editing the invoices rather than only viewing them.
high
Backup copies of originals were made then deleted
Copies of the original invoices were saved to a temporary folder and deleted the same evening.
medium

evidence.title: Registry export of recent documents on AW-09
evidence.description: Export of the user's recent document and program usage keys.
evidence.text:
HKCU/Software/Microsoft/Windows/CurrentVersion/Explorer/RecentDocs  INV-4471.pdf  INV-4488.pdf  INV-4502.pdf
HKCU/Software/PdfEditorPro/RecentFiles  INV-4471.pdf  LastWrite=2026-09-19 18:23:10

findings: Third invoice opened in the editor but not yet checked
INV-4502 also appears in the editor's recent list. The file share shows no write for it, so whether it was changed is still unknown.
low

evidence.title: Reconciliation workbook Q2 as stored on the file share
evidence.description: Workbook that matches payments to invoices for the second quarter.
evidence.text: Sheet Summary: Total invoices 412,330.00. Total payments 377,430.00. Difference 34,900.00 marked 'timing'. Sheet Detail row 118: INV-4471 48,900.00.
custody: Handed over for revision history analysis

findings: Unexplained difference labelled as timing
A difference of 34,900.00 is marked as a timing difference, but the payments register shows no later payment that would clear it.
medium
Workbook last saved the same evening as the invoice changes
The workbook was last saved at 18:41 on 2026-09-19, about twenty minutes after the last invoice write.
medium

evidence.title: Earlier version of the reconciliation workbook from backup
evidence.description: The same workbook as it was on 2026-09-12, restored from the nightly backup.
evidence.text: Sheet Summary: Total invoices 378,330.00. Total payments 377,430.00. Difference 900.00 marked 'rounding'. Sheet Detail row 118: INV-4471 14,900.00.
evidence.method: Backup restore to a separate folder
evidence.notes: Restored by the infrastructure team at the investigators' request.

findings: Earlier workbook agrees with the supplier's invoice amount
In the earlier version row 118 shows 14,900.00 and the difference is only 900.00, which supports the supplier's amount.
high
Edits increased invoice total by exactly the extra 34,000.00
The summary total rose by 34,000.00 between the versions, equal to the change on INV-4471 alone. The remaining changes on the other invoices explain the rest.
medium

evidence.title: Chat export of the finance channel, September
evidence.description: Messages in the finance team channel between 2026-09-14 and 2026-09-30.
evidence.text:
2026-09-19 17:48 acc.rao: audit people arrive on the 29th, I need to tidy up the Northgate paperwork tonight
2026-09-19 17:52 fin.mgr: ok, just keep the originals
2026-09-19 19:05 acc.rao: all done
2026-09-22 09:10 fin.mgr: did you keep the originals?
2026-09-22 09:14 acc.rao: yes they are on my drive
evidence.notes: Export obtained with the workspace administrator's approval.

analyses.notes: Review of message timeline against the file events in progress.
findings: Messages mention tidying paperwork on the evening of the writes
The accountant wrote that the paperwork would be tidied that evening and wrote 'all done' shortly after the last file event. The wording is ambiguous: it could mean formatting, not changing amounts.
info

evidence.title: Direct messages between the accountant and the finance manager
evidence.description: Private messages between the two people, covering 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-24.
evidence.text:
2026-09-18 16:40 fin.mgr: Northgate asked about the old amount again
2026-09-18 16:44 acc.rao: I will look at it
2026-09-24 10:02 fin.mgr: we should not touch the invoices before the audit
2026-09-24 10:05 acc.rao: understood
evidence.notes: Contains personal messages; access limited to the case team.

evidence.title: Supplier statement of account
evidence.description: Statement sent by the supplier listing invoices and amounts as the supplier recorded them.
evidence.text: Northgate Components Ltd statement to 2026-09-30. INV-4471 14,900.00. INV-4488 6,250.00. INV-4502 11,000.00. Balance owed by customer: 32,150.00.

findings: Statement amounts match the supplier's original invoices
All three invoice amounts agree with the copies received in June, which supports that the stored copies were altered.
high

evidence.title: Payments register extract for Northgate
evidence.description: Extract of the payments made to the supplier during the second and third quarters.
evidence.method: Report export from the finance system

findings: Money actually paid matches the supplier, not the altered files
The amounts paid equal the supplier's original invoices, so the altered stored amounts never matched real payments.
high

evidence.title: Memo attributed to the finance manager about the changes
evidence.description: A memo found in the finance folder that appears to authorise correcting the Northgate invoices. It was later found to come from a different person and department.
evidence.text: Memo: Please correct the Northgate invoice amounts to the agreed revised figures before the audit. Signed: finance manager.
evidence.notes: Author field in the document differs from the signature.

withdrawn.reason: Memo was found to belong to a different supplier dispute in another department and was misattributed to this matter.

links: The stored invoice shows 48,900.00 while the supplier's original shows 14,900.00.
The audit log shows the write to the invoice file that matches its modified time.
The workstation image shows the editor use at the same time as the writes in the audit log.
Registry recent file keys agree with the recent files found on the disk image.
The earlier workbook shows 14,900.00 on the line where the current workbook shows 48,900.00.
The chat message about tidying paperwork precedes the evening of the writes.
The supplier statement agrees with the original invoice amount.
The payments made equal the amounts on the supplier statement.
The payment made does not match the amount in the stored invoice.
